ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of fraud in Minnesota's Somali community and the crackdown on a drug trafficking organization in the Twin Cities
questions: What are the allegations of fraud in Minnesota's Somali community?
How is the FBI investigating these allegations?
ideas.insight: I believe this story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud in the state, and I would like to investigate further to see if there are any other entities or individuals involved
